Training Details

dataset.toml

resolutions = [[192, 341] ,[480, 853], [600, 1067]]
enable_ar_bucket = true
min_ar = 0.5
max_ar = 2.0
num_ar_buckets = 7
frame_buckets = [ 1, 16, 33]
[[directory]]
path = "/home/user/beauty_of_rain_dataset/videos"
num_repeats = 1

train.toml

dataset = "/home/user/beauty_of_rain_dataset_14B.toml"
epochs = 60
micro_batch_size_per_gpu = 1
pipeline_stages = 1
gradient_accumulation_steps = 1
gradient_clipping = 1
warmup_steps = 10
eval_every_n_epochs = 1
eval_before_first_step = true
eval_micro_batch_size_per_gpu = 1
eval_gradient_accumulation_steps = 1
save_every_n_epochs = 3
activation_checkpointing = 'unsloth'
partition_method = "parameters"
save_dtype = "bfloat16"
caching_batch_size = 1
steps_per_print = 10
video_clip_mode = "multiple_overlapping"
blocks_to_swap = 32

[model]
type = "wan"
ckpt_path = "/home/user/Wan2.1-T2V-14B"
dtype = "bfloat16"
transformer_dtype = "float8"
timestep_sample_method = "logit_normal"

[adapter]
type = "lora"
rank = 32
dtype = "bfloat16"

[optimizer]
type = 'AdamW8bitKahan'
lr = 5e-5
betas = [0.9, 0.99]
weight_decay = 0.01
stabilize = false

items.name: Beauty of rain [Wan 1.3B]
items.description:
Trigger Word: b3@ut1f0ll_r@in
Model: Wan 2.1 t2i 1.3B
All examples are generated with 1.0 LoRA strength and CFG=6
For inference used Kijai's workflows

Training Details

This is my first attempt to teach lora for Wan 1.3B such a specific movement as painted rain. The dataset included 11 videos from the anime Kotonoha no Niwa (The Garden of Words) with lengths of 16, 30, 60, 72 and 81 frames. Diffusion-pipe was used for training. The training was conducted simultaneously at resolutions 256x456 and 480x854 with num_repeats=1. I used a slightly higher learning rate and as the best model I chose the 54 epoch with lr=8e-05 with LoRA rank of 32.

The version for Wan 14B can be found here https://civitai.com/models/1747192/beauty-of-rain-wan-14b

items.name: Dynamic Shots: Collection of 60 Effects for Dramatic Photography
items.description:
- More cool models.
ℹ️ Fast access to all effects: 60 Moonlight, 58 Profile Portrait, 57 Clear Day Portrait, 56 Christmas Lights, 55 Hard Shadows Portrait, 54 Smoke Action, 53 Two Colors Lighting, 52 Infrared, 51 Dust Shot, 50 Glamour Portrait, 49 Selfie, 48 Tilt Shift Miniature, 47 Face Extreme Close-Up, 46 Polaroid style, 45 Stylized Effect 1, 44 Cyberpunk Portrait, 43 Candlelit, 42 Rim Light, 41 Blue Accent, 40 Motion Blur, 39 Underexposed Lighting, 38 One Side Lighting, 37 Disco Lasers Lighting, 36 White Street Lights, 35 City From Below, 34 Double Exposure Effect, 33 Bokeh Lighting, 32 Fisheye Lens, 31 Sepia Filter, 30 Glass Sphere Perspecti, 29 Ultraviolet Portrait, 28 Red Light Portrait, 27 From Above, 26 Talkshow Angle, 25 Soft Light Portrait, 24 Twilight Cityscapes, 23 Light Trails, 22 Cellphone Lit face, 21 Face Close-Up, 20 Instagram Beauty, 19 Low Angle, 18 Retro Film, 17 Snowy, 16 Rainy, 15 Shadow, 14 Foggy, 13 Water Reflections, 12 Cinematic Street, 11 Lens Flare, 10 Film Noir Style, 09 Astrophotography, 08 Fireworks Photography, 07 Drone Photography, 06 Backlit Portraits, 05 Macro Photography, 04 Underwater, 03 HDR, 02 Golden Hour, 01 Urban Night, 59 Mirror Reflection.
ℹ️ The goal is to provide useful tools to allow better control over the scene, subject, lighting, angles, distance, lenses, perspective, atmosphere, and effects.
ℹ️ I recommend starting with strength 0.6 and adjusting it according to the results.
ℹ️ If the face is small in the image, use Adetailer to add missing details.
ℹ️ Complex prompts, other Loras, and embeddings will compete with the desired effect. Try to simplify your settings to improve the results. If artifacts or distortion appear, lower the strength of the Lora. Keep in mind that the specific model used will influence the results, and some models are not compatible.
ℹ️ Trained on Hyper Realism 3.
ℹ️ Release schedule: All models should be available for all users now, let me know if something is not working.
